notes: 7 train extension to 34th St-Hudson Yards opened Sept 13, 2015 (new twin-tube tunnel + 1 station). Figure is widely and consistently reported (MTA/WSP/Wikipedia project pages) but no NYC-government dataset independently restates it the way DOT restates bus-lane mileage for later years.
